clips.title: The story
paras: Commander Springvale was once a devoted paladin and the head of Baron Silverlaine's armed guard at Shadowfang Keep. Slain alongside his men during the feral worgen slaughter orchestrated by Archmage Arugal, his vengeful spirit remains behind to haunt the castle halls. Even in death, his ghost fiercely guards the keep and seeks vengeance for his fallen master.

Before the ruin of Shadowfang Keep, Commander Springvale stood as an honorable paladin dedicated to the Holy Light and a sworn defender of Baron Silverlaine. Leading the garrison in Silverpine Forest, he oversaw the keep's security during the fraught days following the fall of Lordaeron to the Scourge.
